title: Fenlara Selection Result
description: Output of select(). Every collection keyed by offer identity uses offer_id, never agent_id, so that two offers from the same agent are always distinguishable in the result — this mirrors the decision-key rule in agent-record.schema.json.

chosen.description: The winning offer, or null if every offer was rejected by hard constraints.

scores.description: One entry per surviving offer, keyed by offer_id. Empty if every offer was rejected.

additionalProperties.description: Per-criterion normalized scores (0..1) plus the weighted 'total' actually used to rank this offer.

rejections.description: One entry per rejected offer, keyed by offer_id, listing every hard-constraint reason it failed.

warnings.description: Human-readable notes that do not change the outcome: missing preference attributes scored as 0, ties, or the all-rejected case.

tie_with.description: Present only when 'chosen' was picked by tie-break. Lists the offer_id(s) that scored exactly equal to 'chosen.offer_id' but lost the lexicographic tie-break.
